title: Attack Pack
summary: 200px|rightAttack Pack was a line of monstrous trucks and vehicles designed by Mike McKittrick and others released from 1992 to 1994. The main gimmick of these vehicles was their transforming action when they were pressed down, causing them to open their mouths or perform other actions. They were even available as McDonalds Happy Meal toys, as an option to Barbie dolls.
